title: Launch of Vocational Center
summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Powai is collaborating with Maxx Social Welfare Foundation to launch a Vocational Learning Center at the Maxx Empowerment Center, Powai.
description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Powai is collaborating with Maxx Social Welfare Foundation to launch a Vocational Learning Center at the Maxx Empowerment Center, Powai.

This initiative aims to promote skill development, vocational learning and livelihood opportunities for the community.
We Thank the following members who attended the Inauguration as we take this meaningful step towards community empowerment.
